data.description: Drones are male bees from colonies of social bees.
The primary reproductive female caste of social insects (especially ants, wasps, and bees of order Hymenoptera, as well as termites). Gynes are those destined to become queens.
In termites, the king helps found the colony with the queen and will continue to mate with the queen during his life.
In some species the workers and soldiers are dimorphic (of two sizes), with the larger individuals called major soldiers or workers and the smaller ones called minor soldiers or workers

The Queen is the only female within a colony of social insects that can reproduce.
An adult eusocial insect capable of reproduction of unspecified sex (queen/gyne/drone).
Sterile members of a eusocial insect colony whose primary function is defense.
Worker insects are those within social insect colonies (bees, ants, wasps and termites) that are not capable of reproducing.

metadata.description: Castes are groups of individuals within the same species of social insects that have a different appearance. This appearance is usually related to the role of that caste within the colony. https://www.amentsoc.org/insects/glossary/terms/castes/
